opportunities.name: Case law lookup, statute lookup, and note
opportunities.description: For a given court case, find it on CourtListener, open the case, look up the related US Code statute on Cornell LII, and save a summary note with citation, decision date and statute.
steps: Open CourtListener case law search
Type case name in keyword search and press Enter
Open the matching case result
Read citation and decision date
Go to Cornell LII and search the statute citation
Open the statute page and read its title
Open Notes, create new note with 'Case: citation, decided date. See statute (title)' and press Enter

opportunities.name: arXiv paper search, Semantic Scholar citations, and note
opportunities.description: For a topic and year, run an arXiv advanced search restricted to that year, open the top paper, look it up on Semantic Scholar for author and citation count, and save a note.
steps: Open arXiv Advanced search
Enter search term
Select specific year date filter and type the year
Click Search and open the top result
Copy the paper title
Search the title on Semantic Scholar and open the result
Read first author and citation count
Add a note 'topic (year): title by author, N citations'

opportunities.name: PeerSpace venue search
opportunities.description: Search PeerSpace for venues by activity type and city.
steps: Click activity field, select all, type activity
Click location field, select all, type city
Choose matching city option from the dropdown
Click Search

opportunities.name: 1-800-Flowers product search
opportunities.description: Search 1800flowers for a flower type and open a result.
steps: Click the search box, select all
Type flower query and press Enter
Open the desired product link
